subject.title: docs(install): add vendor-neutral NVIDIA Jetson install guide

question: Should OpenClaw accept a vendor-neutral NVIDIA Jetson install guide in first-party docs, and should turnkey hardware references be omitted or routed outside core docs?
rationale: The PR is a docs addition rather than a runtime fix, and the linked issue explicitly asks maintainers to set the boundary between first-party hardware setup docs and vendor or ClawHub promotion.

options.title: Accept After Source-Backed Repair
options.body: Accept the vendor-neutral Jetson guide after the NVIDIA setup guidance is corrected and the page omits commercial turnkey hardware references.

options.title: Route Jetson Guidance Outside Core
options.body: Close or pause the PR and ask contributors to keep Jetson-specific setup guidance in vendor, community, or ClawHub-owned documentation.

options.title: Defer Until Hardware Smoke Proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a maintainer or contributor provides real Jetson setup proof plus the docs repair.

recommendation.title: Accept After Source-Backed Repair
recommendation.body: Accept the vendor-neutral Jetson guide after the NVIDIA setup guidance is corrected and the page omits commercial turnkey hardware references.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the listed project maintainer and has recent VISION/ClawHub docs policy history that frames first-party docs scope.
